english: Sign in to post ads and report bad ones. Browsing is free, no account needed.
translation: Gal si aad xayeysiis u dhigto ama aad u sheegto kuwa xun. Daawashadu waa bilaash, akoon looma baahna.

english: No password needed. We only use your name and email from Google.
translation: Furaha sirta ah looma baahna. Google waxaan ka qaadanaa magacaaga iyo iimaylkaaga oo keliya.

english: You will accept our Terms in the next step.
translation: Tallaabada xigta waxaad aqbali doontaa Shuruudahayaga.

english: Sign-in was cancelled. You can try again.
translation: Galitaanka waa la joojiyey. Mar kale isku day.

english: Sign-in did not work. Please try again.
translation: Galitaanku ma shaqeyn. Fadlan mar kale isku day.

english: Your Google email is not verified yet. Please verify it with Google and try again.
translation: Iimaylkaaga Google weli lama xaqiijin. Ka xaqiiji Google kadibna mar kale isku day.

english: This account is blocked. If you think this is a mistake, contact us.
translation: Akoonkan waa la xiray. Haddii aad u malaynayso inay khalad tahay, nala soo xiriir.

english: Sign-in with Google is not set up yet on this site.
translation: Ku gelidda Google weli laguma diyaarin boggan.

english: Only on your own computer, for testing. This box never shows on the live site.
translation: Kaliya kombiyuutarkaaga, si aad u tijaabiso. Sanduuqan weligiis kama muuqdo bogga rasmiga ah.

english: Buyers will use these details to contact you. You can change them later.
translation: Iibsadayaashu waxay faahfaahintan u isticmaali doonaan inay kula soo xiriiraan. Hadhow waad beddeli kartaa.
Ku soo dhowow! Akoonkaagu waa diyaar.

english: Somali mobile number, for example 61 5123456. Buyers see it only after tapping "Show number".
translation: Lambar mobile Soomaaliyeed, tusaale 61 5123456. Iibsadayaashu waxay arkaan marka ay riixaan "Muuji lambarka" oo keliya.

english: I use WhatsApp on this number
Please enter a Somali mobile number, for example 61 5123456.
translation: Fadlan geli lambar mobile Soomaaliyeed, tusaale 61 5123456.

english: This phone number cannot be used on iibsom. Contact us if you think this is a mistake.
translation: Lambarkan lagama isticmaali karo iibsom. Nala soo xiriir haddii aad u malaynayso inay khalad tahay.

english: Our team checked this seller's ID
Buyers trust verified sellers more. Send a clear photo of your ID. Our team checks that the name matches your account.
translation: Iibsadayaashu aad bay ugu kalsoon yihiin iibiyeyaasha la xaqiijiyey. Soo dir sawir cad oo aqoonsigaaga ah. Kooxdayadu waxay hubinaysaa in magacu la mid yahay akoonkaaga.

english: All 4 corners visible, no glare, name and photo easy to read. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB.
translation: 4-ta gees oo muuqda, iftiin la'aan, magaca iyo sawirka si fudud loo akhrin karo. JPG, PNG ama WebP, ilaa 8 MB.

english: I agree that iibsom staff look at this photo to check my name. It is kept encrypted and deleted after the check.
translation: Waan oggolahay in shaqaalaha iibsom ay eegaan sawirkan si ay u hubiyaan magacayga. Si qarsoodi ah ayaa loo kaydiyaa, waana la tirtiraa hubinta kadib.

english: Please tick the box to agree.
translation: Fadlan calaamadee sanduuqa si aad u oggolaato.

english: Thank you. Our team will check your ID soon.
translation: Mahadsanid. Kooxdayadu dhowaan ayay hubin doontaa aqoonsigaaga.

english: We are checking your ID. You do not need to do anything.
translation: Waxaan hubinaynaa aqoonsigaaga. Waxba ha samayn.

english: You are verified. The badge shows next to your name on your ads.
translation: Waa lagu xaqiijiyey. Calaamaddu waxay ka muuqataa magacaaga agtiisa xayeysiisyadaada.

english: We could not verify your ID: :reason
You can send a new photo below.
translation: Waxaad hoos ka soo diri kartaa sawir cusub.

english: Your ID photo is never shown to buyers. It is stored encrypted and deleted as soon as our team decides.
translation: Sawirka aqoonsigaaga weligii lama tuso iibsadayaasha. Si qarsoodi ah ayaa loo kaydiyaa, waana la tirtiraa marka kooxdayadu go'aan gaarto.

english: A shop page shows your logo, opening hours and all your ads at one web address you can share.
translation: Bogga dukaanku wuxuu muujiyaa astaantaada, saacadaha furitaanka iyo dhammaan xayeysiisyadaada hal cinwaan oo aad wadaagi karto.

english: Small letters, numbers and - only. Your page: :url
translation: Xarfo yaryar, lambarro iyo - oo keliya. Boggaaga: :url

english: Use small letters (a-z), numbers and - only, for example: abdi-motors.
translation: Isticmaal xarfo yaryar (a-z), lambarro iyo - oo keliya, tusaale: abdi-motors.

english: Another shop already uses this web address. Try another one.
translation: Dukaan kale ayaa isticmaala cinwaankan. Isku day mid kale.

english: Square picture works best. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
translation: Sawir laba-jibbaaran ayaa ugu fiican. JPG, PNG ama WebP, ilaa 5 MB.

english: Your shop page is not public yet. Contact us to turn it on (monthly plan).
translation: Bogga dukaankaagu weli ma furna. Nala soo xiriir si loo furo (qorshe bille ah).

english: Your shop page is public until :date.
translation: Bogga dukaankaagu wuu furan yahay ilaa :date.

english: This shop has no ads right now.
Make a key so an app can post and manage YOUR ads for you. Only give a key to an app you trust.
translation: Samee fure si app uu kuugu dhigo oo u maamulo XAYEYSIISYADAADA. Fure sii oo kaliya app aad aaminsan tahay.

english: Allow this key to post, edit, mark sold and delete my ads (without this it can only read)
translation: U oggolow furahan inuu dhigo, beddelo, iibsaday ka dhigo oo tirtiro xayeysiisyadayda (la'aanteed wuxuu kaliya akhrin karaa)

english: Copy it now and keep it secret. You will not see it again.
translation: Hadda koobiyee oo qarsoodi ku hay. Mar dambe ma arki doontid.

english: Delete this key? Apps using it will stop working.
translation: Ma tirtiraysaa furahan? App-yada isticmaala way joogsan doonaan.

english: You can have up to :count keys. Delete one to make a new one.
translation: Waxaad yeelan kartaa ilaa :count fure. Mid tirtir si aad mid cusub u sameyso.

english: Lost a phone or think a key was seen? Delete the key here at once. Keys end after one year.
translation: Taleefan ma kaa lumay ama ma u malaynaysaa in fure la arkay? Halkan ka tirtir isla markiiba. Furayaashu waxay dhamaadaan hal sano kadib.

english: New to selling? 6 tips to sell fast
translation: Ma ku cusub tahay iibinta? 6 talo oo dhakhso loogu iibiyo

english: Pick the best category. It helps buyers find your ad.
translation: Dooro qaybta ugu habboon. Waxay ka caawisaa iibsadayaasha inay helaan xayeysiiskaaga.

english: We brought back what you typed last time.
translation: Waxaan soo celinnay wixii aad qortay markii hore.

english: Search a category, e.g. phone, car, house
translation: Raadi qayb, tusaale: taleefan, baabuur, guri

english: No category with that name. Try another word.
translation: Qayb magacaas leh lama helin. Isku day eray kale.

english: Tips for an ad that sells
Add 3 or more clear photos in daylight. The first photo is the one buyers see in lists.
translation: Ku dar 3 sawir ama ka badan oo cad oo iftiinka maalinta lagu qaaday. Sawirka koowaad ayaa iibsadayaashu ku arkaan liisaska.

english: Write what it is in the title: brand, model, size or year.
translation: Cinwaanka ku qor waxa uu yahay: nooca, moodalka, cabbirka ama sannadka.

english: Give a fair price. The price guide below shows what similar ads ask.
translation: Dhig qiime macquul ah. Hagaha qiimaha ee hoose wuxuu muujinayaa waxa xayeysiisyada la midka ahi weydiinayaan.

english: Be honest in the description: say what is good and what is not. It saves time for you and the buyer.
translation: Sharraxaadda ku noqo daacad: sheeg waxa fiican iyo waxa aan fiicnayn. Waqti ayay adiga iyo iibsadahaba idiin badbaadinaysaa.

english: How buyers will see your ad
translation: Sida iibsadayaashu u arki doonaan xayeysiiskaaga

english: This is the card in lists and search results.
translation: Kani waa kaarka ka muuqda liisaska iyo natiijooyinka raadinta.

english: Thank you! Your ad was sent
Our team checks every ad to keep iibsom safe. Your ad will be live soon, usually within a few hours.
translation: Kooxdayadu waxay hubisaa xayeysiis kasta si iibsom u ahaado meel ammaan ah. Xayeysiiskaagu dhowaan ayuu soo bixi doonaa, inta badan saacado gudahood.

english: Send it to friends and groups. More people see it, it sells faster.
translation: U dir saaxiibbada iyo kooxaha. Marka dad badani arkaan, si dhakhso ah ayuu u iibsamaa.

english: You can share your ad as soon as it is live. We tell you in the bell.
translation: Waxaad la wadaagi kartaa xayeysiiskaaga marka uu shaqeeyo. Waxaan kugu ogeysiin doonnaa gambaleelka.

english: Every 7 days you can move your ad to the top of the list again, free. Find the button in My ads.
translation: 7-dii maalmoodba mar waxaad xayeysiiskaaga kor ugu qaadi kartaa liiska, bilaash. Badhanka ka hel Xayeysiisyadayda.

english: Middle price $:middle, from :count ads in the last 6 months. You choose your own price.
translation: Qiimaha dhexe $:middle, laga soo qaaday :count xayeysiis 6dii bilood ee la soo dhaafay. Qiimahaaga adigaa go'aansanaya.

english: From buyers who talked with this seller on iibsom.
translation: Waxaa qoray iibsadayaal la hadlay iibiyahan iibsom dushiisa.
Ma waxaad qoyskaaga wax uga iibsanaysaa dibadda?

english: Ask someone you trust in :city to see the item and meet the seller first.
translation: Weydii qof aad aaminsan tahay oo jooga :city inuu marka hore arko alaabta oo la kulmo iibiyaha.

english: Never send money before they have seen it and it is handed over.
translation: Weligaa lacag ha dirin ka hor intaanay arkin oo aan la gacansiin.

english: Keep the seller's number and agree everything in writing.
translation: Kaydso lambarka iibiyaha oo wax walba ku heshiiya qoraal.

english: Up to :max photos. The first photo is the cover. Drag to change the order.
translation: Ilaa :max sawir. Sawirka koowaad waa kan hore. Jiid si aad u beddesho kala horreynta.

english: Short and clear, e.g. "Toyota Vitz 2012, automatic".
translation: Gaaban oo cad, tusaale "Toyota Vitz 2012, otomaatig".

english: What is it like? Any problems? Why are you selling?
translation: Sidee buu yahay? Wax dhibaato ah ma leeyahay? Maxaad u iibinaysaa?

english: You already posted this ad. Edit the old one instead.
translation: Xayeysiiskan horay ayaad u dhigtay. Wax ka beddel kii hore.

english: You can post up to :count ads per day. Please try again tomorrow.
translation: Maalintii waxaad dhigi kartaa ilaa :count xayeysiis. Fadlan berri isku day.

english: Upload failed. Tap to remove and try again.
translation: Soo gelintu way fashilantay. Riix si aad u saarto oo mar kale isku day.

english: Too many photos waiting. Post your ad or remove some photos first.
translation: Sawirro badan ayaa sugaya. Marka hore dhig xayeysiiskaaga ama saar sawirro.

english: You can add up to :max photos.
translation: Waxaad ku dari kartaa ilaa :max sawir.

english: {1} 1 more ad shown|[2,*] :count more ads shown
translation: {1} 1 xayeysiis oo kale ayaa la tusay|[2,*] :count xayeysiis oo kale ayaa la tusay

english: {0} No results|{1} Show 1 result|[2,*] Show :count results
translation: {0} Natiijo ma jirto|{1} Tus 1 natiijo|[2,*] Tus :count natiijo
Kuwa ugu badan ee la daawaday

english: {0} No results for :what in :where|{1} 1 result for :what in :where|[2,*] :count results for :what in :where
translation: {0} Wax natiijo ah looma helin :what gudaha :where|{1} 1 natiijo oo :what ah gudaha :where|[2,*] :count natiijo oo :what ah gudaha :where

english: Try fewer filters or other words.
translation: Isku day shaandheyn yar ama erayo kale.

english: {1} :what in :where: 1 ad right now.|[2,*] :what in :where: :count ads right now.
translation: {1} :what gudaha :where: hadda 1 xayeysiis.|[2,*] :what gudaha :where: hadda :count xayeysiis.

english: Call, WhatsApp or chat with sellers directly. Posting your own ad is free.
translation: Si toos ah ula xiriir iibiyeyaasha: wac, WhatsApp ama fariin u dir. Dhigista xayeysiiskaagu waa bilaash.
Isku day adigoo ka saaraya mid ka mid ah:
{1} 1 jeer la daawaday|[2,*] :count jeer la daawaday

english: Meet in a busy public place and see the item first. Never send money before.
translation: Ku kulma meel dadweyne oo mashquul ah oo marka hore arag alaabta. Weligaa lacag hore ha u dirin.
{1} 1 xayeysiis oo muuqda|[2,*] :count xayeysiis oo muuqda

english: Hello, I saw your ad “:title” on iibsom: :url
translation: Salaan, waxaan iibsom ku arkay xayeysiiskaaga “:title”: :url

english: Only if you want our team to answer you. Only staff see it.
translation: Kaliya haddii aad rabto in kooxdayadu kuu jawaabaan. Shaqaalaha kaliya ayaa arka.

english: Please choose a reason. A phone number or email must look right.
translation: Fadlan dooro sabab. Lambarka taleefanka ama iimaylku waa inuu sax yahay.
Si loo joojiyo robots: imisa waa :a + :b?

english: We don't keep your IP address or put a cookie on your phone for this.
translation: Uma haynno cinwaankaaga IP mana dhigno cookie taleefankaaga tan awgeed.

english: Thank you. Our team will check this ad.
translation: Mahadsanid. Kooxdayadu way hubin doontaa xayeysiiskan.

english: You reported this ad. Thank you.
Meet in a busy public place.
translation: Ku kulma meel dadweyne oo mashquul ah.

english: See the item before you pay.
translation: Arag alaabta ka hor intaadan lacag bixin.

english: Only you can see this ad. Status: :status
translation: Adiga oo keliya ayaa arki kara xayeysiiskan. Xaaladda: :status

english: Have one like this to sell?
translation: Ma haysaa mid kan oo kale oo aad iibinayso?

english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
translation: Wax baa khaldamay. Fadlan mar kale isku day.

english: Please remove web links. Buyers contact you by phone or WhatsApp.
translation: Fadlan ka saar linkiyada internetka. Iibsadayaashu waxay kula soo xiriiraan taleefan ama WhatsApp.

english: Please remove rude or unsafe words from your ad.
translation: Fadlan xayeysiiskaaga ka saar erayada xun ama aan ammaanka ahayn.

english: Drugs are not allowed on iibsom (khat, cannabis, narcotics, medicines that need a doctor, and anything similar). Please remove them. See the posting rules in Help.
translation: Daroogo laguma oggola iibsom (qaad, xashiish, maandooriye, daawooyin u baahan dhakhtar iyo wax la mid ah). Fadlan ka saar. Eeg xeerarka dhigista xayeysiiska ee Caawimaadda.

english: Ad closed. You can renew it later from "Ended".
translation: Xayeysiiska waa la xiray. Hadhow waad cusboonaysiin kartaa "Dhammaaday".

english: Done. Your ad is at the top of the lists again.
translation: Waa la sameeyey. Xayeysiiskaagu mar kale wuxuu ku jiraa liisaska korkooda.

english: You can move this ad up again on :date.
translation: Xayeysiiskan mar kale waad kor u qaadi kartaa :date.

english: Free move to top again on :date
translation: Kor u qaadid bilaash ah mar kale :date

english: Mark this ad as sold? Buyers will not see it any more.
translation: Ma calaamadeysaa in xayeysiiskan la iibiyey? Iibsadayaashu ma arki doonaan mar dambe.

english: Delete this ad? This cannot be undone.
translation: Ma tirtirtaa xayeysiiskan? Dib looma soo celin karo.

english: Fix the ad and save it. We will check it again.
translation: Sax xayeysiiska oo keydi. Mar kale ayaan hubin doonnaa.

english: Saved. Our team checks the changes before they go live.
translation: Waa la keydiyey. Kooxdayadu waxay hubisaa isbeddelada ka hor inta aysan muuqan.
Waxaa lagu calaamadeeyey in la iibiyey. Hambalyo!

english: Renewed. Your ad is live until :date.
translation: Waa la cusbooneysiiyey. Xayeysiiskaagu wuu muuqanayaa ilaa :date.

english: After you save, our team checks the ad again before it is live.
translation: Markaad keydiso kadib, kooxdayadu mar kale ayay hubin doontaa xayeysiiska ka hor inta uusan muuqan.

english: Saved. Find it in Saved ads.
translation: Waa la kaydiyey. Ka hel Xayeysiisyada la kaydiyey.
Waa laga saaray xayeysiisyadaada la kaydiyey.

english: You can save up to :max ads. Remove some first.
translation: Waxaad kaydin kartaa ilaa :max xayeysiis. Marka hore qaar ka saar.

english: No saved ads yet. Tap Save on an ad to keep it here.
translation: Weli xayeysiis lama kaydin. Riix Kaydi xayeysiis si aad halkan ugu hayso.
Gal si aad xayeysiisyo u kaydiso

english: Alerts paused. The search stays here; turn alerts on again any time.
translation: Ogeysiisyada waa la joojiyey. Raadintu halkan ayay joogtaa; mar kasta dib u daar.
Ogeysiisyada mar kale waa la daaray.

english: Sign in to save this search
translation: Gal si aad raadintan u kaydiso

english: We email you once a day when new ads match one of these searches.
translation: Maalintii hal mar ayaan kuu soo diraynaa iimayl marka xayeysiisyo cusub ay la mid noqdaan raadintan mid ka mid ah.

english: Search saved. We will email you when new ads match it.
translation: Raadinta waa la kaydiyey. Iimayl ayaan kuu soo diri doonnaa marka xayeysiisyo cusub la helo.

english: You can save up to :max searches. Delete one first.
translation: Waxaad kaydin kartaa ilaa :max raadin. Marka hore mid tirtir.

english: Choose a category or type a word first, then save the search.
translation: Marka hore dooro qayb ama qor eray, kadib kaydi raadinta.

english: Search deleted. No more emails for it.
translation: Raadinta waa la tirtiray. Iimayl dambe looma soo diri doono.

english: Delete this saved search? You will get no more emails for it.
translation: Ma tirtirtaa raadintan la kaydiyey? Iimayl dambe ma heli doontid.

english: No saved searches yet. On a list of ads, tap "Save this search".
translation: Weli raadin lama kaydin. Liiska xayeysiisyada, riix "Kaydi raadintan".
Daawashooyinka maalintii (14-kii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay)

english: Only numbers are counted. We never keep who looked at your ad. Your own visits are not counted.
translation: Tirada oo keliya ayaa la tiriyaa. Weligeen ma kaydinno cidda eegtay xayeysiiskaaga. Booqashooyinkaaga lama tiriyo.

english: Few views? Add clear photos, a good title and a fair price.
translation: Daawasho yar? Ku dar sawirro cad, cinwaan wanaagsan iyo qiime caddaalad ah.

english: Boosted ads show first in lists, with a label, so more buyers see them.
translation: Xayeysiisyada kor loo qaaday waxay ka muuqdaan liisaska bilowgooda, calaamad leh, si iibsadayaal badan u arkaan.

english: TEST MODE: payments are being tested. Do not send real money.
translation: HABKA TIJAABADA: lacag-bixinta waa la tijaabinayaa. Ha dirin lacag dhab ah.

english: Send the price of your package to one of these numbers, then fill in the form below.
translation: U dir qiimaha xirmadaada mid ka mid ah lambarradan, kadib buuxi foomka hoose.

english: Use only letters, numbers, dots and dashes, as in the SMS.
translation: Isticmaal xarfo, lambarro, dhibco iyo xariiqyo oo keliya, sida SMS-ka.

english: This transaction ID was already used. Check the SMS and try again.
translation: Aqoonsigan macaamilka horay ayaa loo isticmaalay. Hubi SMS-ka oo isku day mar kale.

english: Thank you. Our team will check your payment and start the boost.
translation: Mahadsanid. Kooxdayadu waxay hubin doontaa lacag-bixintaada, kadibna kor u qaadista ayaa bilaabanaysa.

english: We are checking a payment for this ad. You can boost again after that.
translation: Waxaan hubinaynaa lacag-bixin xayeysiiskan ah. Taas kadib mar kale ayaad kor u qaadi kartaa.

english: Boosts are not available right now.
translation: Kor u qaadistu hadda lama heli karo.

english: {1} 1 year on iibsom|[2,*] :count years on iibsom
translation: {1} 1 sano ku jira iibsom|[2,*] :count sano ku jira iibsom

english: {1} 1 month on iibsom|[2,*] :count months on iibsom
translation: {1} 1 bil ku jira iibsom|[2,*] :count bilood ku jira iibsom
Si dhakhso ah ayuu u jawaabaa

english: Usually answers buyers within an hour
translation: Badanaa wuxuu iibsadayaasha ugu jawaabaa saacad gudaheed

english: Sign in to chat with the seller
translation: Gal si aad ula sheekaysato iibiyaha

english: No messages yet. Open an ad and tap "Chat with seller".
translation: Weli fariin ma jirto. Fur xayeysiis oo riix "La sheekayso iibiyaha".

english: This ad is no longer on the site.
This chat is blocked. No more messages can be sent.
translation: Sheekadan waa la xannibay. Fariimo kale lama diri karo.

english: This person can no longer receive messages.
translation: Qofkan hadda fariimo ma heli karo.

english: Sorry, this message was not sent. Talking about drugs (khat, cannabis, pills and similar) is not allowed on iibsom. Please write about the item only.
translation: Waan ka xunnahay, fariintan lama dirin. Ka hadalka daroogada (qaad, xashiish, kiniin iyo wax la mid ah) laguma oggola iibsom. Fadlan ka qor alaabta oo keliya.

english: Your message has words that are not allowed. Please change it.
translation: Fariintaadu waxay leedahay erayo aan la oggolayn. Fadlan beddel.

english: Block this chat? Neither of you can send more messages.
translation: Ma xannibaysaa sheekadan? Midkiinna fariimo kale ma diri karo.

english: The chat opens with your offer written in. You still tap Send.
translation: Wada-hadalku wuxuu ku furmayaa dalabkaaga oo qoran. Adigaa weli riixaya Dir.

english: Hello, I would like to offer :amount for this. Is that OK for you?
translation: Salaan, waxaan doonayaa inaan ku bixiyo :amount. Ma kuu fiican tahay?

english: {1} 1 chat with new messages|[2,*] :count chats with new messages
translation: {1} 1 wada-hadal oo fariimo cusub leh|[2,*] :count wada-hadal oo fariimo cusub leh

english: Stay safe: never send money before you see the item. Meet in a busy place.
translation: Ammaan ahaw: weligaa lacag ha dirin intaadan arag alaabta. Ku kulma meel mashquul ah.

english: Say hello and ask about the ad. Your phone number is not shown here.
translation: Salaan oo wax ka weydii xayeysiiska. Lambarkaaga taleefanka halkan laguma muujiyo.

english: Only buyers who talked with the seller can rate. Be fair: rate the seller, not the price.
translation: Kaliya iibsadayaasha la hadlay iibiyaha ayaa qiimeyn kara. Caddaalad ahow: qiimee iibiyaha, ma aha qiimaha.

english: e.g. Honest, the phone was as in the photos.
translation: tusaale: Waa daacad, taleefanku wuxuu ahaa sidii sawirrada.

english:
## Before you pay
- **Meet in a busy, public place** in daylight.
- **See the item first.** Check it works before you pay.
- **Never send money in advance** (EVC, Zaad, Sahal, eDahab) for something you have not seen.
- For cars, houses and land, **check the papers** and who really owns it.

## Warning signs
- The price is much lower than normal.
- The seller is in a hurry or will not meet.
- They ask for a deposit, a fee or your PIN.

## Something wrong?
Press **Report this ad** on the ad page. Our team checks every report.
translation:
## Ka hor intaadan lacag bixin
- **Ku kulma meel dadweyne oo mashquul ah** maalinnimo.
- **Marka hore arag alaabta.** Hubi inay shaqeyso ka hor intaadan bixin.
- **Weligaa lacag hore ha dirin** (EVC, Zaad, Sahal, eDahab) wax aadan arag.
- Baabuurta, guryaha iyo dhulka, **hubi waraaqaha** iyo cidda dhab ahaan leh.

## Calaamadaha digniinta
- Qiimuhu aad buu uga hooseeyaa sida caadiga ah.
- Iibiyuhu wuu degdegayaa ama ma rabo inuu kula kulmo.
- Waxay ku weydiinayaan lacag hore, khidmad ama PIN-kaaga.

## Wax khaldan ma jiraa?
Riix **Ka warbixi xayeysiiskan** bogga xayeysiiska. Kooxdayadu way hubisaa warbixin kasta.

english:
iibsom uses **only what the site needs to work**. No advertising cookies, no tracking by other companies.

## Cookies
- **iibsom-session** and **XSRF-TOKEN**: keep you signed in and protect forms. Only when you sign in or send a form.
- **lang**: remembers the language you chose (1 year).

## Saved in your browser only (never sent to us)
- Ads you looked at, for "Recommended for you".
- Grid or list view, the money you want prices shown in, and an ad you are still writing.

You can delete all of these in your browser settings at any time. The site still works, you just have to choose again.

Visitors who are not signed in: we do not store their IP address.
translation:
iibsom waxay isticmaashaa **oo keliya waxa bogga ugu baahan yahay inuu shaqeeyo**. Ma jiraan kukiyo xayeysiis ah, mana jiro shirkad kale oo ku raad-raacda.

## Kukiyada
- **iibsom-session** iyo **XSRF-TOKEN**: waxay kaa dhigaan mid gudaha ku jira oo ilaaliya foomamka. Kaliya marka aad gasho ama aad foom dirto.
- **lang**: waxay xasuusataa luqadda aad dooratay (1 sano).

## Waxa lagu keydiyo browser-kaaga oo keliya (marnaba nooma yimaado)
- Xayeysiisyada aad eegtay, si loogu talo galo "Adiga laguu soo jeediyey".
- Muuqaalka shabaq ama liis, lacagta aad rabto in qiimaha lagu muujiyo, iyo xayeysiis aad wali qorayso.

Kuwaas oo dhan waad tirtiri kartaa goor kasta oo ka mid ah dejinta browser-kaaga. Boggu wuu shaqeynayaa, kaliya mar kale ayaad dooran doontaa.

Booqdayaasha aan soo gelin: ma keydinno ciwaankooda IP.

english:
## Your photos or text used without permission
If an ad uses your photo, logo or text without your permission, tell us and we will check it quickly.

Send us:
- the link to the ad,
- what is yours (for example: "the first 3 photos"),
- how we can reach you.

Use **Report this ad** on the ad page, or the help email at the bottom of the page.

## Other problems
- A fake ad, a scam or a rude message: press **Report this ad**.
- Something on the site does not work: write to the help email and tell us what you did and what you saw.

Our team checks every report. If the ad breaks the rules, we remove it.

Haddii xayeysiis uu isticmaalo sawirkaaga, astaantaada ama qoraalkaaga adigoo aan oggolaan, noo sheeg, si dhakhso ah ayaan u hubin doonnaa.

Kooxdayadu way hubisaa warbixin kasta. Haddii xayeysiisku jebiyo xeerarka, waan saarnaa.

english: How to sell fast on iibsom

Selling on iibsom is free. These 6 steps help buyers find your ad and trust you.

1. **Post your ad.** Tap **Sell**, choose the category and fill in the details. Our team checks every ad before it goes live. [How to post an ad](:help_url/post-an-ad)
2. **Take good photos.** Daylight, a clean background, the whole item and close-ups. Up to :max_photos photos; the first one is the main photo. [Good photos](:help_url/good-photos)
3. **Give a fair price.** Look at similar ads first. Ads with a price get more calls than "Negotiable".
4. **Write the important details.** Year, size, condition, what is included. Buyers skip ads that leave them guessing.
5. **Answer quickly.** Keep your phone on and reply to calls and messages. Sellers who answer fast sell faster.
6. **Meet safely.** Meet in a busy public place, and never send money first. [Safety tips](:safety_url)

When it is sold, press **Mark as sold** in **My ads**, so buyers stop calling. Ads end after :expiry_days days; you can renew them in **My ads**.
translation:
Ka iibinta iibsom waa bilaash. 6-dan tallaabo ayaa iibsadayaasha ka caawiya inay helaan xayeysiiskaaga oo ay kugu kalsoonaadaan.

1. **Dhig xayeysiiskaaga.** Riix **iibi**, dooro qaybta oo buuxi faahfaahinta. Kooxdayadu waxay hubisaa xayeysiis kasta ka hor inta uusan muuqan. [Sida loo dhigo xayeysiis](:help_url/post-an-ad)
2. **Qaad sawirro wanaagsan.** Iftiinka maalinta, gadaal nadiif ah, alaabta oo dhan iyo meelo dhow. Ilaa :max_photos sawir; kan koowaad waa sawirka ugu muhiimsan. [Sawirro wanaagsan](:help_url/good-photos)
3. **Dhig qiimo cadaalad ah.** Marka hore eeg xayeysiisyo la mid ah. Xayeysiisyada qiimaha leh waxay helaan wicitaanno ka badan kuwa "Waa laga wada hadli karaa".
4. **Qor faahfaahinta muhiimka ah.** Sannadka, cabbirka, xaaladda, iyo waxa ku jira. Iibsadayaashu way ka gudbaan xayeysiisyada aan wax cad sheegin.
5. **Si dhakhso ah u jawaab.** Taleefankaaga daar oo ka jawaab wicitaannada iyo fariimaha. Iibiyeyaasha si dhakhso ah u jawaaba ayaa dhakhso u iibiya.
6. **Si ammaan ah u kulma.** Ku kulma meel dadweyne oo mashquul ah, hana lacag hore u dirin. [Talooyin ammaan](:safety_url)

Marka la iibiyo, riix **Calaamadee waa la iibiyey** gudaha **Xayeysiisyadayda**, si iibsadayaashu u joojiyaan wicitaanka. Xayeysiisyadu waxay dhammaadaan :expiry_days maalmood kadib; waad cusboonaysiin kartaa gudaha **Xayeysiisyadayda**.

english:
Posting is free.

1. Tap **Sell** at the bottom of the screen (or **Post an ad** at the top).
2. Sign in with Google. The first time, add your name, city and phone number.
3. Choose the category, for example **Cars**.
4. Add up to :max_photos photos. The first photo is the main one.
5. Write a short, clear title, for example "Toyota Vitz 2012, automatic".
6. Fill in the details, the price and your city.
7. Tap **Post my ad**.

Our team checks every ad before it goes live. You can post up to :max_per_day ads a day.

3. Dooro qaybta, tusaale **Baabuur**.
4. Ku dar ilaa :max_photos sawir. Sawirka koowaad waa kan ugu muhiimsan.
5. Qor cinwaan gaaban oo cad, tusaale "Toyota Vitz 2012, otomaatig".
6. Buuxi faahfaahinta, qiimaha iyo magaaladaada.
7. Riix **Dhig xayeysiiskayga**.

Kooxdayadu waxay hubisaa xayeysiis kasta ka hor inta uusan muuqan. Maalintii waxaad dhigi kartaa ilaa :max_per_day xayeysiis.

- Marka hore muuji alaabta oo dhan, kadibna faahfaahinta iyo cilad kasta.
- Isticmaal sawirradaada. Sawirro internetka laga soo guuriyey waa la diidi karaa.
- Ha ku qorin lambar taleefan ama qoraal sawirrada. Iibsadayaashu lambarkaaga waxay ka arkaan bogga xayeysiiska.
- Jiid sawir si aad u beddesho kala horreynta. Sawirka koowaad ayaa ka muuqda liisaska.

english:
Every new ad is checked by our team, so buyers see real ads.

- **Waiting for approval:** we have not checked it yet. You do not need to do anything.
- **Live:** everyone can see your ad.
- **Rejected:** open **My ads** to see why. Fix the ad and save it. We will check it again.

When you change a live ad, it is checked again before the new version shows.
translation:
Xayeysiis kasta oo cusub kooxdayada ayaa hubisa, si iibsadayaashu u arkaan xayeysiisyo dhab ah.

- **Wuxuu sugayaa oggolaansho:** weli ma aanan hubin. Waxba ha samayn.
- **Wuu shaqaynayaa:** qof walba wuu arki karaa xayeysiiskaaga.
- **Waa la diiday:** fur **Xayeysiisyadayda** si aad u aragto sababta. Sax xayeysiiska oo kaydi. Mar kale ayaan hubin doonnaa.

Markaad beddesho xayeysiis shaqaynaya, mar kale ayaa la hubiyaa ka hor inta nuqulka cusub uusan muuqan.

english:
We check every ad before it goes live. Follow these rules and your ad goes live faster.

## Every ad must

- Be a **real item or service** that you have now, in Somalia.
- Have **your own photos** of the item. No photos from the internet.
- Be in the **right category** and the right city.
- Have a **real price** in US dollars (or tick "Negotiable").
- Be **one ad for one item**. Do not post the same thing again: renew or move the old ad up instead.

## Not allowed

- Weapons, bullets and anything made to hurt people.
- Alcohol.
- Stolen things, fake or copied brands, fake documents, ID cards or passports.
- Animals that are protected by law, and wild animals.
- Adult content, or anything that insults a person, clan or religion.
- Jobs or "business offers" that ask you to pay first.
- Links to other websites, and asking buyers to pay before they see the item.

## Not allowed: drugs

iibsom does not allow any drugs. Drugs harm people and families, and selling them can break the law. This includes:

- **Khat** (qaad, jaad, miraa), fresh or dry.
- **Narcotics** such as heroin, cocaine and opium.
- **Cannabis** (weed, marijuana, hashish) in any form.
- **Prescription medicines** (for example tramadol, codeine, diazepam) unless you are a licensed pharmacy.
- **Drug tools** such as pipes, bongs and rolling papers.
- Anything similar, under any other name.

Ads with these words are refused when you post or edit them. If we find such an ad later, we take it off the site. Report any ad like this with **Report this ad → Drugs**.

## Why an ad is not approved

- **Photos are not clear or not real:** add your own clear photos in daylight.
- **Wrong category:** choose the category that fits best.
- **Price is missing or not real:** write the real price.
- **Duplicate ad:** you already have the same ad. Use that one.

Open **My ads** to see the reason, fix the ad and save it. We check it again. Breaking the rules many times can block your account.
translation:
Xayeysiis kasta waan hubinnaa ka hor inta uusan soo bixin. Raac xeerarkan, xayeysiiskaagu si dhakhso ah ayuu u soo baxayaa.

## Xayeysiis kasta waa inuu

- Ahaadaa **alaab ama adeeg dhab ah** oo aad hadda haysato, Soomaaliya gudaheeda.
- Lahaadaa **sawirro adiga aad qaaday** oo alaabta ah. Sawirro internetka laga soo qaaday ma aha.
- Ku jiraa **qaybta saxda ah** iyo magaalada saxda ah.
- Lahaadaa **qiime dhab ah** oo doollar ah (ama calaamadee "Waa laga wada hadli karaa").
- Ahaadaa **xayeysiis keliya oo hal alaab ah**. Mar kale ha dhigin isla wixii: cusboonaysii ama kor u qaad kii hore.

## Lama oggola

- Hub, xabbad iyo wax kasta oo loogu talagalay in dadka lagu dhibaateeyo.
- Khamri.
- Alaab la xaday, summado been ah ama la koobiyeeyey, dukumentiyo been ah, kaarar aqoonsi ama baasaboorro.
- Xayawaanka sharcigu ilaaliyo iyo xayawaanka duurjoogta ah.
- Wax anshax-xumo ah, ama wax caayaya qof, qabiil ama diin.
- Shaqooyin ama "ganacsi" kaa doonaya inaad marka hore lacag bixiso.
- Xiriiriyeyaal bogag kale, iyo in iibsadaha laga codsado inuu lacag bixiyo intuusan arag alaabta.

## Lama oggola: daroogo

iibsom ma oggola daroogo nooc kasta ha ahaatee. Daroogadu waxay dhibaato u keentaa dadka iyo qoysaska, iibinteeduna waxay jebin kartaa sharciga. Waxaa ka mid ah:

- **Qaad** (jaad, miraa), cagaar ama qalalan.
- **Maandooriye** sida heroin, cocaine iyo opium.
- **Xashiish** (cannabis, marijuana) nooc kasta.
- **Daawooyinka u baahan warqad dhakhtar** (tusaale tramadol, codeine, diazepam) haddii aadan ahayn farmashiye ruqsad haysta.
- **Qalabka daroogada** sida tuubooyinka, bong iyo waraaqaha la duubo.
- Wax kasta oo la mid ah, magac kasta ha lagu sheego.

Xayeysiisyada leh ereyadan waa la diidaa marka la dhigayo ama la beddelayo. Haddii aan hadhow helno xayeysiis noocaas ah, waan ka saaraynaa bogga. Ka warbixi xayeysiis kasta oo noocan ah: **Ka warbixi xayeysiiskan → Daroogo**.

## Sababta xayeysiis loo diido

- **Sawirradu ma cadda ama ma aha kuwo dhab ah:** ku dar sawirro adiga aad qaaday oo cad, maalin cad.
- **Qayb khaldan:** dooro qaybta sida fiican ugu habboon.
- **Qiimaha ma jiro ama ma aha mid dhab ah:** qor qiimaha dhabta ah.
- **Xayeysiis labanlaaban:** horey ayaad u haysataa isla xayeysiiskaas. Isticmaal kaas.

Fur **Xayeysiisyadayda** si aad u aragto sababta, sax xayeysiiska oo kaydi. Mar kale ayaan hubinaynaa. Haddii xeerarka marar badan la jebiyo, akoonkaaga waa la xiri karaa.
Wax ka beddel, la iibiyey, cusbooneysii ama tirtir

english:
Open **Account** → **My ads**.

- **Edit:** change the photos, text or price.
- **Mark as sold:** the ad leaves the site and buyers stop calling you.
- **Renew:** ads end after :expiry_days days. **Renew** shows :renew_days days before the end and gives your ad :expiry_days more days.
- **Delete:** the ad is removed for good.
translation:
Fur **Akoon** → **Xayeysiisyadayda**.

- **Wax ka beddel:** beddel sawirrada, qoraalka ama qiimaha.
- **Calaamadee waa la iibiyey:** xayeysiisku wuu ka baxaa bogga, iibsadayaashuna way joojiyaan inay ku soo wacaan.
- **Cusbooneysii:** xayeysiisyadu waxay dhacaan :expiry_days maalmood kadib. **Cusbooneysii** wuxuu muuqdaa :renew_days maalmood ka hor dhammaadka, xayeysiiskaagana wuxuu siiyaa :expiry_days maalmood oo kale.
- **Tirtir:** xayeysiiska gebi ahaanba waa la saaraa.
Si ammaan ah wax u iibso

english:
- Meet in a busy, public place in daylight.
- See the item before you pay. Check that it works.
- Never send money first (EVC Plus, Zaad, Sahal, eDahab) for something you have not seen.
- For cars, houses and land, check the papers and who really owns it.
- A price that is much lower than normal is a warning sign.

Read all our [safety tips](:safety_url).
translation:
- Ku kulma meel dadweyne oo mashquul ah, maalinnimo.
- Arag alaabta ka hor intaadan lacag bixin. Hubi inay shaqeyso.
- Weligaa lacag hore ha dirin (EVC Plus, Zaad, Sahal, eDahab) wax aadan arag.
- Baabuurta, guryaha iyo dhulka, hubi waraaqaha iyo cidda dhab ahaan leh.
- Qiime aad uga hooseeya sida caadiga ah waa calaamad digniin ah.

Akhri dhammaan [talooyinkayaga ammaanka](:safety_url).

english:
1. **Find it.** Search, or open a category and use the filters (price, city, condition). Save a search to hear about new ads.
2. **Look closely.** Read the whole ad and look at every photo. Check the seller: how long they are on iibsom and their stars.
3. **Ask.** Tap **Show number** to call or WhatsApp, or use the chat if it is on. Ask about anything that is not clear. You can also make an offer.
4. **Meet and check.** Meet in a busy, public place in daylight. See the item and check that it works before you pay.
5. **Pay safely.** Pay only when you have the item. Never send money first (EVC Plus, Zaad, Sahal, eDahab) for something you have not seen.
6. **Something wrong?** Tap **Report this ad**. We check every report.

Read more: [Buy safely](:safety_url).
translation:
1. **Hel.** Raadi, ama fur qayb oo isticmaal shaandheynta (qiimaha, magaalada, xaaladda). Kaydi raadin si aad u ogaato xayeysiisyada cusub.
2. **Si fiican u eeg.** Akhri xayeysiiska oo dhan oo eeg sawir kasta. Hubi iibiyaha: muddada uu joogo iibsom iyo xiddigihiisa.
3. **Weydii.** Riix **Muuji lambarka** si aad u wacdo ama WhatsApp ugu dirto, ama isticmaal sheekaysiga haddii uu shaqeynayo. Weydii wax kasta oo aan cadayn. Waxaad sidoo kale soo jeedin kartaa qiime.
4. **Kulan oo hubi.** Ku kulma meel mashquul ah oo dadweyne, maalin cad. Arag alaabta oo hubi inay shaqeyso intaadan lacag bixin.
5. **Si ammaan ah u bixi.** Lacagta bixi oo keliya marka alaabtu gacantaada ku jirto. Weligaa lacag ha dirin marka hore (EVC Plus, Zaad, Sahal, eDahab) wax aadan arag.
6. **Wax khaldan ma jiraan?** Riix **Ka warbixi xayeysiiskan**. Warbixin kasta waan hubinnaa.

Wax badan akhri: [Si ammaan ah wax u iibso](:safety_url).

english:
We want every buyer and seller to feel safe on iibsom. This is what we do, and what you can do.

## What iibsom does

- **:checked_line
- **Your number is not in the page.** It shows only after a buyer taps **Show number**, so robots cannot collect it.
- **Bad ads are stopped.** Ads with rude words, web links or drugs (khat, cannabis, pills and similar) are refused when they are posted or changed. Chat messages about drugs are not sent.
- **Anyone can report.** Every ad has a **Report this ad** button, also for people who are not signed in. We check every report.
- **Cheats are removed.** People who break the rules are banned, their ads are taken down and their phone number is blocked.
- **We keep little about you.** We do not keep the internet address (IP) of visitors who are not signed in. Saved history like "Recently viewed" stays on your own phone.
- **Our staff sign in with two steps** (a password and a code from their phone).

## What you can do

1. Meet in a busy, public place in daylight. Bring a friend for big buys.
2. See and check the item before you pay. **Never send money first** (EVC Plus, Zaad, Sahal, eDahab).
3. iibsom will **never** call or message you to ask for a code, a password or money.
4. If something feels wrong, stop and tap **Report this ad**.

More tips: [Stay safe](:safety_url).
translation:
Waxaan rabnaa in iibsade iyo iibiye kastaa uu ammaan ku dareemo iibsom. Kani waa waxa aan sameyno, iyo waxa adigu sameyn kartid.

## Waxa iibsom sameyso

- **:checked_line
- **Lambarkaagu kuma qorna bogga.** Wuxuu muuqdaa oo keliya marka iibsade taabto **Muuji lambarka**, si aanay robotyadu u ururin.
- **Xayeysiisyada xun waa la joojiyaa.** Xayeysiisyada leh erayo xun, link-yo internet ama daroogo (qaad, xashiish, kiniin iyo wax la mid ah) waa la diidaa marka la dhigayo ama la beddelayo. Fariimaha chat-ka ee ku saabsan daroogada lama diro.
- **Qof kasta wuu soo sheegi karaa.** Xayeysiis kasta wuxuu leeyahay badhanka **Ka warbixi xayeysiiskan**, xitaa dadka aan soo gelin. Warbixin kasta waan hubinnaa.
- **Khaayinnada waa la saaraa.** Dadka jebiya xeerarka waa la mamnuucaa, xayeysiisyadooda waa la dejiyaa, lambarkooduna waa la xiraa.
- **Wax yar ayaan kaa haynaa.** Ma kaydinno cinwaanka internetka (IP) ee booqdayaasha aan soo gelin. Taariikhda sida "Kuwii aad dhowaan eegtay" waxay ku jirtaa taleefankaaga oo keliya.
- **Shaqaalahayagu waxay ku soo galaan laba tallaabo** (furaha sirta ah iyo koodh taleefankooda ka yimaada).

## Waxa adigu sameyn kartid

1. Kula kulan meel dadweyne oo dad badani joogaan, maalin cad. Iibsiga waaweyn saaxiib la soo kaxee.
2. Arag oo hubi alaabta ka hor intaadan lacag bixin. **Weligaa lacag ha hormarin** (EVC Plus, Zaad, Sahal, eDahab).
3. iibsom **marnaba** kuuma soo wacayso, fariinna kuuma soo dirayso si ay kaaga codsato koodh, furaha sirta ah ama lacag.
4. Haddii wax aan sax ahayn dareento, jooji oo taabo **Ka warbixi xayeysiiskan**.

Talooyin dheeraad ah: [Ammaan ahaw](:safety_url).

english:
See a scam, a wrong category or something that is not allowed?

1. Open the ad.
2. Tap **Report this ad** (you need to be signed in).
3. Choose what is wrong and send.

Our team checks every report. The seller does not see who reported the ad.
translation:
Ma aragtay khiyaano, qayb khaldan ama wax aan la oggolayn?

1. Fur xayeysiiska.
2. Riix **Ka warbixi xayeysiiskan** (waa inaad gashaa akoonkaaga).
3. Dooro waxa khaldan oo dir.

Kooxdayadu way hubisaa warbixin kasta. Iibiyuhu ma arko cidda ka warbixisay.

english:
- **Sign in:** tap **Sign in** and choose your Google account. We never see your Google password.
- **Change your name, city or phone:** **Account** → **Edit profile**.
- **Your phone number:** buyers see it on your ads after they tap **Show phone number**.
- **Language:** tap **English** or **Soomaali** at the top of any page.
- **Delete your account:** write to us and we will remove your account and your ads. Our email is at the bottom of the [Help page](:help_url).
translation:
- **Gal:** riix **Gal** oo dooro akoonkaaga Google. Weligeen ma aragno furaha sirta ah ee Google-kaaga.
- **Beddel magacaaga, magaaladaada ama taleefankaaga:** **Akoon** → **Wax ka beddel akoonka**.
- **Lambarkaaga taleefanka:** iibsadayaashu waxay ku arkaan xayeysiisyadaada markay riixaan **Muuji lambarka**.
- **Luqadda:** riix **English** ama **Soomaali** xagga sare ee bog kasta.
- **Tirtir akoonkaaga:** noo soo qor, akoonkaaga iyo xayeysiisyadaada ayaan tirtiri doonnaa. Iimaylkayagu wuxuu ku qoran yahay xagga hoose ee [bogga Caawimaadda](:help_url).
